newsitem.title: USA: Enserch, Enterprise in US Gulf pact.
newsitem.headline: Enserch, Enterprise in US Gulf pact.

text.p: Enserch Exploration Inc and Enterprise Oil Plc said Tuesday they have agreed to joint oil exploration venture in the deep water of the Gulf of Mexico.
The companies said Enterprise will pay Enserch $65 million for a 50 percent share of Enserch's deepwater portfolio.

The agreement, which includes approximately 80 blocks in the areas of Garden Banks, Green Canyon, and Mississippi Canyon, is subject to government approvals and certain pre-emption right on some of the blocks.
Excluded from the agreement are Enserch's reserves at Green Canyon 254 and reserves and production facilities Garden Banks 338.
Another $35 million payment by Enterprise is contingent upon drilling successes and the announcement of commercial development, the companies said in a joint statement.

The companies will drill 10 to 12 wells over the next two and a half years using two rigs capable of drilling in 3,300 feet of water, they said. The first well has already been spudded on Garden Banks 386.
